import os

%load_ext watermark

%watermark
%watermark --iversions

    os.environ.get('JUPYTER_IMAGE', '').split(':')[-1] or
    os.environ.get('NEURODESKTOP_VERSION', 'unknown')
)

print(f"Neurodesktop version: {neurodesktop_version}")
